sources.entry: PicoShare - Minimalist, easy-to-host service for sharing images and other files. (Clients) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

summary.name: PicoShare
summary.one_liner: PicoShare is a minimalist, self-hosted web app for sharing files of any type and size through direct download links.
use_cases: Share large files with anyone via a direct link
Host your own image or media sharing service
Share videos or audio without waiting for re-encoding
Replicate a small self-hosted file store to cloud storage
Run a private file drop behind a single admin passphrase
summary.what_it_does: PicoShare is a self-hosted web app for uploading and sharing files. Each uploaded file gets a direct download link that recipients can open without ads or signups. It does not restrict file size, file type, or media format, and it does not resize or re-encode uploads. Data is stored in an SQLite database, and an optional Litestream integration can replicate it to Litestream-compatible cloud storage and restore it on container restart. An admin login is protected by a passphrase set via environment variable or file.
notable: Direct download links with no ads or signups
No re-encoding or resizing of uploaded media
Optional Litestream replication to cloud storage
Licensed AGPL-3.0; maintained by Michael Lynch as a hobby project
caveats: Only one Docker container per Litestream location; writes cannot sync across multiple instances
Deleted files do not free disk space until the SQLite database is manually vacuumed
Feature scope is limited and the maintainer may reject contributions
